card.en: Too many plugs in one outlet can overheat. Unplug some!

tip.en: One outlet, one or two plugs. Unplugging some stops it from overheating.

card.en: A damaged cord can shock you. Unplug it and ask an adult to replace it.

tip.en: With dry hands, pull the plug, never the cord. Then an adult can replace it.

card.en: Cords under rugs can overheat and get damaged. Keep cords out in the open.

tip.en: A cord needs air and must not be stepped on. Move it out from under the rug.

card.en: Water and electricity don't mix. Keep the floor dry near plugs.

tip.en: Never touch a plug near water, and never with wet hands. An adult switches it off first.

card.en: Keep plugged-in things away from water.

tip.en: With dry hands, move it away from the sink so it can never get splashed.

card.en: Open wires are dangerous. Tell an adult to put a cover on.

tip.en: Never touch open wires. An adult fixes the cover.

card.en: Never put anything into an outlet. Tell an adult right away.

tip.en: Don't pull it out yourself. Tell an adult right away.

card.en: Keep electrical panels closed. Only adults should open them.

tip.en: Only adults open or close an electrical panel. Tell one.

card.en: People can trip and pull the cord. Run cords along the wall.

tip.en: Move the cord along the wall so nobody trips on it.

card.en: Water near plugs is dangerous. Tell an adult and keep away.

tip.en: Keep away from the wet plug and tell an adult.

card.en: Don't touch open electrical boxes. Tell an adult.

tip.en: Don't touch an open electrical box. Tell an adult.

card.en: A leaning post can fall. Stay away and report it.

tip.en: Stay far away from a leaning post. An adult reports it to the power company.
Never climb near power lines. Call an adult.

card.en: Branches on wires can spark. Stay away and report it.

tip.en: Don't try to move it. Stay away and an adult reports it.

card.en: Stay far away from fallen wires and the water around them. Call an adult.

tip.en: Never touch a fallen wire or the water near it. Stay far away and call an adult.

label.en: Kite caught on a power line

card.en: Never try to get a kite off a power line. Fly kites in open fields.

tip.en: Let the kite go. An adult calls the power company.

label.en: Climbing a tree near power lines

card.en: Never climb trees near power lines.

tip.en: Climb down carefully and stay away from the wires. Tell an adult.

card.en: A wire on a fence can make the fence dangerous. Don't touch it.

tip.en: Don't touch the fence. Stay away and call an adult.
